title: Contributions to the change in the employment rate aged 16-64, 2019 to 2026 Q2
source: ONS Labour Force Survey (LMS), seasonally adjusted; ukmacro calculations
note: Groups: men and women by age band. Base = 2019 average. Midpoint (Shapley) weights, so composition + within-group = total change exactly. Within-group contributions only: each group's rate change weighted by its population share.
